text:
Ava: Quick sync — proposed scope for 'lift-and-shift' packaging for on‑prem VPC customers. Goals: 1) minimal runtime agent (no k8s), 2) predictable egress control (customer-provided NAT or relay), 3) in-place upgrade with <2min p95 downtime, 4) offline installer for airgap. Need :eyes: and objections by EOD.

Sam: IP preservation question — for customers who must keep the same egress IP, do we support source-IP passthrough or just mapping via NAT? Is SNAT-only acceptable for first phase?

Priya: Launch-criteria proposal: - Pilot upgrades at 2 customers (one NATed, one IP-preserved) - Operator smoke tests green (matrix below) - Docs + rollback playbook published - Privacy sign-off for telemetry. Also add: no schema changes to the admin API during launch.

Diego: Packaging notes — field installs care about size & dependencies. Offline installer should be a single tarball + detached signature. Suggest: use sha256 digest + detached GPG sig. Example verification: `gpg --verify agent.tar.gz.sig agent.tar.gz`.

Sam: For customer-managed networking we should list modes explicitly: DIRECT (customer routes traffic to agent), RELAY (customer-hosted relay/proxy), and RELAY+PIN (relay + egress IP pinning). Each has different ops burden and rollback semantics.

Lewis: KMS/HSM constraints — offline/airgap installs must support importing encrypted key blobs and local rotation. Add an acceptance test: import -> sign -> rotate -> verify.

Emma: Rollout plan suggestion: canary at 5% tenants -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback if p50 latency regresses >200ms or error rate >0.5%. Also require fallback to hosted-compatible model variant if local model fails.

Ava: Short config example for ops doc:
```
# agent.conf (example)
mode = "agent"
egress = { type = "relay", address = "relay.example.local:443" }
upgrade_window = "2m"
telemetry = { enabled = false }
```

Priya: Security note: telemetry must be opt-in for private deployments; any payloads must be hashed/anonymized. Security will block launch if plaintext telemetry is emitted.

Diego: Action items I/O: produce offline-installer spec + signature flow, include sample `install.sh` stub that validates sig and checks free disk.

Emma: Also define rollback SLA: for Dedicated/private customers we should commit to <1hr rollback window in the contract for major upgrades. Ops needs runbook automation to hit that.

Ava: Action items (assigned): 1) Priya -> draft launch criteria ticket + security checklist; 2) Diego -> offline installer spec + gpg sig flow; 3) Lewis -> KMS import/rotate acceptance tests; 4) Sam -> network modes doc + topology diagrams; 5) Emma -> rollout/rollback runbook. I'll schedule field-pilot sync Monday 10am. :calendar:

ops-bot: PR #4823 created by Diego: add-offline-installer-spec (https://git.internal/r/4823) :white_check_mark:

Priya: +1 from security in thread — will escalate if telemetry is not opt-in or if signatures aren't verifiable.

Sam: FYI: customer ask from NetCorp — they require source-IP preservation and deterministic upgrade order across 4 proxies. Adding to pilot acceptance.

Ava: Noted. I'll add NetCorp as pilot candidate and capture deterministic-order requirement in the rollout ticket.

Emma: ping on docs ownership for rollback steps — who takes lead?

Ava: Sam will own network diagrams, Priya will own security/playbook, Emma will own rollout steps. Diego & Lewis will supply test artifacts.

Sam: Copy. I'll sketch diagrams and a one-page cheat sheet for field ops. :+1:

Ava: Thanks all. If no major objections by EOD we'll lock scope and open the launch-criteria RFC. :shipit:
